event: Goal by Rivera, 89th minute, Lions lead 2-1
commentary: Rivera at the death! The Lions snatch the lead in the 89th minute and the stadium is shaking!

event: Penalty saved by goalkeeper Okafor, score stays 0-0
commentary: Okafor guesses right and pushes it away! The penalty is saved and it stays goalless!

event: Hat-trick for Mendes, Rovers now 3-0 up
commentary: That is a hat-trick for Mendes! Three goals, three moments of magic, and Rovers are cruising at 3-0!

event: Free kick by Costa hits the top corner, 1-1
commentary: Costa steps up and curls it into the top corner! An absolute screamer levels it at 1-1!

event: Red card for defender Haugen, Lions down to ten men
commentary: Haugen is sent off for that challenge. The Lions will have to manage the rest of the game with ten men.

event: Half time, Rovers 1-0 United
commentary: The referee blows for half time. Rovers take a narrow one goal lead into the break against United.

event: Own goal by Patel, United 0-1 City
commentary: Oh dear, Patel finds the net, just the wrong one. City lead 1-0 and Patel would like the ground to swallow him.

event: Last-minute winner by Silva in the cup final, 2-1
commentary: Silva wins the cup in the final minute! 2-1, and the fans are pouring onto the pitch in disbelief!

event: Substitution, Mendes off, Kowalski on, 70th minute
commentary: A change in the 70th minute. Mendes makes way for Kowalski, fresh legs for the final twenty.

event: Striker Banda misses an open goal from two yards
commentary: Banda from two yards and somehow it goes over the bar. Physics professors are still trying to explain that one.

event: Comeback complete, City win 4-3 after trailing 3-1
commentary: What a comeback! City were 3-1 down and they have won it 4-3! What a game!

event: VAR rules out goal by Diallo for offside, score 0-0
commentary: After a long review, Diallo's goal is ruled out for offside. It remains 0-0.

event: Bicycle kick goal by Nunez, 2-0 to Rovers
commentary: Nunez with an overhead kick! Unbelievable acrobatics and Rovers double their lead at 2-0!

event: Six by Sharma to win the match off the last ball
commentary: Sharma launches it into the stands off the very last ball! SIX! They have won it and the dugout erupts!

event: Hat-trick for bowler Iyer, three wickets in three balls
commentary: Iyer has done it! Three wickets in three balls, a hat-trick, and the batting side is in pieces!

event: Century for Rao, 100 runs off 58 balls
commentary: Rao raises the bat! A century off just 58 balls, a breathtaking display of power hitting!

event: Rain stops play, Tigers 145 for 3 after 30 overs
commentary: The covers are coming on as rain stops play. Tigers are well placed at 145 for 3 after 30 overs.

event: Stunning one-handed catch by Khan at deep midwicket
commentary: Khan flies to his left and plucks it out of the air with one hand! What a catch at deep midwicket!

event: Batter Menon run out after a mix-up with his partner
commentary: Menon says yes, his partner says no, and the bails are off. Someone is buying dinner tonight.

event: Drinks break, Eagles need 80 runs from 60 balls
commentary: Time for drinks. The Eagles need 80 from the last 60 balls, a stiff but achievable target.

event: Clean bowled, Kapoor's yorker takes middle stump
commentary: Bowled him! Kapoor fires in a perfect yorker and the middle stump is cartwheeling away!

event: Four boundaries in a row by Das, 16 runs from the over
commentary: Four, four, four, four! Das is on fire, sixteen runs from the over and the bowler has nowhere to hide!

event: Maiden over bowled by Nair, score 60 for 2
commentary: A maiden over from Nair, tight and disciplined. The score stays at 60 for 2.

event: Bowler Joshi bowls a wide that goes for five runs
commentary: Joshi sends it so wide the keeper needs a passport. Five wides, and that one will be on the blooper reel.

event: Super over tied, match goes to a second super over
commentary: It is tied again! Even the super over cannot separate them and we are going to a second one! Incredible scenes!

event: Debutant Verma takes five wickets for 20 runs
commentary: A dream debut for Verma! Five wickets for just 20 runs, and a new star is born!

event: Buzzer-beater three by Johnson, Hawks win 101-100
commentary: Johnson from deep at the buzzer... BANG! The Hawks win it 101-100 and the arena explodes!

event: Slam dunk by Okoro over two defenders
commentary: Okoro rises over two defenders and throws it down! That is a poster dunk for the ages!

event: Timeout called by Bulls coach, trailing 88-80 in the fourth
commentary: The Bulls coach calls timeout. They trail by eight in the fourth and need to regroup.

event: Triple-double for Morgan, 25 points 12 rebounds 10 assists
commentary: Morgan completes the triple-double! 25 points, 12 boards and 10 assists, a complete masterclass!

event: Air ball by center Petrov on a free throw
commentary: Petrov at the line and that one touched nothing but air. The rim filed a missing person report.

event: Block by Adeyemi seals the win, Suns 98-96
commentary: Rejected! Adeyemi swats it into the third row and the Suns hang on to win 98-96!

event: End of third quarter, Celtics lead 75-70
commentary: That ends the third quarter. The Celtics hold a five point lead, 75-70, heading into the fourth.

event: Ten straight points by Reyes, Knights take the lead
commentary: Reyes cannot miss! Ten straight points on his own and the Knights are suddenly in front!

event: Foul out, Thompson leaves with six fouls
commentary: That is Thompson's sixth foul and he has fouled out. A big loss for his team down the stretch.

event: Alley-oop from Chen to Williams in overtime
commentary: Chen lobs it, Williams slams it! An alley-oop in overtime and the crowd is on its feet!

event: Point guard Lee dribbles the ball off his own foot out of bounds
commentary: Lee dribbles it straight off his own foot. Even the ball looked embarrassed as it rolled away.

event: Ace on match point, Novak wins the final 7-6
commentary: An ace on match point! Novak wins the final 7-6 in the decider and drops to the court in joy!

event: Break of serve for Garcia, leads 5-4 in the third set
commentary: Garcia breaks! A huge moment, she leads 5-4 in the third and will serve for the match!

event: Medical timeout for Petrova, trailing 2-4
commentary: Petrova is taking a medical timeout, down 2-4. The trainer is having a look at her shoulder.

event: Forty-shot rally won by Alvarez with a drop shot
commentary: Forty shots and Alvarez finishes it with a delicate drop shot! What a rally, the crowd is on its feet!

event: Player Smith smashes his racket after a double fault
commentary: Double fault, and Smith takes it out on the racket. The racket did nothing wrong, but it has paid the price.

event: Tiebreak in the second set, score 6-6
commentary: We go to a tiebreak in the second set at six games all. Every point matters now.

event: Comeback from two sets down, Kim wins in five
commentary: Kim was two sets down and has won it in five! One of the great comebacks on this court!

event: Passing shot winner down the line by Rossi to save break point
commentary: Rossi rips a passing shot down the line! Break point saved in stunning style!

event: Rain delay on Centre Court, first set 3-3
commentary: Rain has arrived and play is suspended on Centre Court with the first set level at three games all.

event: Ball hits the net cord and dribbles over for a winner
commentary: Off the net cord and it just trickles over. Rossi raises a hand to apologise, but he will take the point.

event: Overtake for the lead by Hamid on the final lap
commentary: Hamid goes around the outside on the final lap and takes the lead! What a move, and what a finish!

event: Pole position for rookie Laurent by 0.05 seconds
commentary: Pole position for the rookie Laurent! Just five hundredths of a second, an astonishing lap!

event: Safety car deployed after crash at turn 4
commentary: The safety car is out following an incident at turn 4. The field will bunch up behind it.

event: Fastest lap by Ortega with two laps to go
commentary: Ortega sets the fastest lap with two to go! He is flying and the gap is shrinking fast!

event: Pit stop takes 12 seconds after wheel problem for Becker
commentary: Twelve seconds in the pits for Becker. The crew are looking for that wheel nut like it owes them money.

event: Red flag, race suspended due to heavy rain
commentary: The red flag is out and the race is suspended. Conditions are simply too wet to continue.

event: First career win for Laurent at the home Grand Prix
commentary: Laurent wins his home Grand Prix! A first career victory and the home crowd is going wild!

event: Engine failure forces Becker to retire on lap 30
commentary: Smoke from the back of the car and that is the end of Becker's race. Engine failure on lap 30.

event: Three-wide battle into turn 1 at the start
commentary: Three wide into turn 1! Nobody is backing out and somehow they all make it through!

event: Overtime goal by Larsen, Wolves win 3-2
commentary: Larsen scores in overtime! The Wolves win it 3-2 and the bench empties onto the ice!

event: Glove save by goalie Moreau on a breakaway
commentary: Breakaway, and Moreau snatches it with the glove! A stunning save to keep it level!

event: Two-minute penalty for tripping on Svensson
commentary: Svensson goes to the box for two minutes for tripping. A power play coming up.

event: Fight breaks out, both players lose their helmets
commentary: The gloves are off and so are the helmets. Not much skill on display, but plenty of enthusiasm.

event: Short-handed goal by Becker ties the game 2-2
commentary: A short-handed goal! Becker steals it and buries it, and we are tied at 2-2!

event: End of second period, Bears lead 1-0
commentary: That is the end of the second period. The Bears carry a slim 1-0 lead into the third.

event: Empty-net goal seals the win for the Bears, 4-2
commentary: Into the empty net! The Bears seal it at 4-2 and the celebrations can begin!

event: Super raid by Pawan, four points in one raid
commentary: A super raid from Pawan! Four points in a single raid and the defence has been torn apart!

event: Super tackle by Rahul on the last raid, Panthers win by one
commentary: Super tackle! Rahul brings down the raider on the final raid and the Panthers win by a single point!

event: All out inflicted, Warriors gain two bonus points
commentary: That is an all out. The Warriors pick up two bonus points and the opposition will need to rebuild.

event: Raider slips on the mat and steps out of bounds
commentary: He slips, he slides, and he is out of the court all by himself. The defenders did not even need to try.

event: Bonus point and touch point for Ajay, Bulls take the lead
commentary: Ajay grabs the bonus and a touch point! The Bulls edge in front in a thrilling contest!

event: Half time, Thalaivas 18-15 Bulls
commentary: Half time in this contest. Thalaivas lead the Bulls 18-15 after a tight opening half.

event: Equaliser by Ahmed in stoppage time, 2-2
commentary: Ahmed in stoppage time! It is 2-2 and there is still time for more drama!

event: Yellow card for midfielder Tanaka for a late tackle
commentary: Tanaka goes into the book for a late tackle. He will need to be careful now.

event: Penalty shootout won by United, 5-4
commentary: United win the shootout 5-4! The final kick goes in and the players sprint to their goalkeeper!

event: Last-wicket partnership wins the match by one wicket
commentary: The last pair have done it! A one wicket win, nerves of steel from the tail-enders!

event: Review taken, umpire's decision of not out stays
commentary: The review shows the ball missing leg stump. The umpire's call of not out stands.

event: Steal and breakaway layup by Garcia to tie it at 90
commentary: Garcia picks his pocket and goes the length! The layup is good and we are tied at 90!

event: Half-court shot by Brooks goes in at the halftime buzzer
commentary: Brooks heaves it from half court... and it drops! Unbelievable at the halftime buzzer!

event: Underarm serve winner by Dubois on break point
commentary: An underarm serve on break point! Cheeky, brilliant, and it wins Dubois the point!

event: Ortega passes two cars in one corner after the restart
commentary: Ortega dives down the inside and takes two cars in one corner! A sensational restart!

event: Natural hat-trick for Larsen in the third period
commentary: A natural hat-trick for Larsen! Three straight goals in the third and the hats are raining down!

event: Pawan reaches 1000 career raid points
commentary: History for Pawan! One thousand career raid points, a true legend of the mat!

event: Goalkeeper Brandt comes up for a corner and scores a header
commentary: The goalkeeper is up for the corner and Brandt heads it in! His strikers will never hear the end of this.

event: Dog runs onto the field and stops play
commentary: Play is stopped by a dog with excellent fielding instincts. Better ground coverage than some of the slips today.

event: Set point saved by Kim, score 5-6
commentary: Kim saves the set point with a solid first serve. She trails 5-6 but is still in this set.

event: Free throws made by Morgan, Hawks extend lead to 7
commentary: Morgan makes both at the line. The Hawks extend their lead to seven.
